sources.title: Imitation Learning Policies | huggingface/lerobot | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: This page documents the imitation learning (IL) policies included in LeRobot: ACT, Diffusion, VQ-BeT, Multitask DiT, and TD-MPC. All policies learn to reproduce demonstrated behavior from LeRobotDataset recordings. This page covers architecture internals, configuration parameters, and training behavior for each.
